name: Git
shortDescription: The distributed version control system every developer uses. Learn commits, branches, merging, rebasing, undoing mistakes and team workflows.
highlights: Remotes, undoing changes and team workflows

name: GitHub
shortDescription: The platform where code is hosted, reviewed and shipped. Learn repositories, pull requests, issues, code review, releases, Pages and open-source collaboration.
highlights: Pull requests, code review and issues

name: GitLab
shortDescription: An all-in-one DevOps platform: repositories, merge requests, CI/CD pipelines, container registry and issue tracking in a single application.

name: Linux
shortDescription: The operating system of servers and the cloud. Learn the terminal, files and permissions, processes, package managers, networking and shell basics.
highlights: The shell, navigation and file management

name: Docker
shortDescription: Package applications with their dependencies into portable containers. Learn images, Dockerfiles, volumes, networking, registries and Docker Compose.
highlights: Images, containers and the Docker CLI
Volumes, networks and Compose for multi-service apps

name: Kubernetes
shortDescription: The container orchestration standard. Learn pods, deployments, services, ingress, configuration, storage and how clusters keep applications running.
highlights: Services, ingress, config maps and secrets

name: Jenkins
shortDescription: The long-standing open-source automation server. Learn pipelines as code, agents, plugins, credentials and continuous delivery for any stack.

name: GitHub Actions
shortDescription: CI/CD built into GitHub. Learn workflows, jobs, runners, marketplace actions, secrets, matrices and deployment pipelines.

name: Terraform
shortDescription: Infrastructure as code for any cloud. Learn HCL, providers, resources, state, variables, modules and the plan/apply workflow.
highlights: Workspaces, remote state and best practices

name: AWS
shortDescription: Amazon Web Services, the largest cloud platform. Learn the core services: IAM, EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, VPC and how to deploy real applications.
highlights: Accounts, IAM and the AWS CLI
Serverless with Lambda and deploying an app

name: Microsoft Azure
shortDescription: Microsoft's cloud platform. Learn resource groups, App Service, Functions, Storage, Azure SQL, identity and integration with Azure DevOps.
highlights: Subscriptions, resource groups and the portal
App Service, Functions, Storage and databases

name: Google Cloud Platform
shortDescription: Google's cloud platform: Compute Engine, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, Firebase integration and IAM.
highlights: Projects, IAM and the gcloud CLI
Cloud Run, Compute Engine and Cloud Storage

name: Nginx
shortDescription: The high-performance web server and reverse proxy. Learn configuration, static hosting, load balancing, TLS termination and caching.
highlights: Installation, configuration files and server blocks
TLS with Let's Encrypt, caching and tuning

name: Apache HTTP Server
shortDescription: The classic, modular web server. Learn virtual hosts, .htaccess, modules, URL rewriting, TLS and hosting PHP applications.

name: Postman
shortDescription: The API client for exploring, testing and documenting HTTP APIs. Learn requests, collections, environments, scripted tests and automation.

name: VS Code
shortDescription: The most popular code editor. Learn the essential shortcuts, extensions, debugging, integrated terminal, Git integration, settings and productivity features.
highlights: Interface, shortcuts and the command palette
Debugging, Git integration and remote development
